prompt: Proposed mark: 'KLARNSTRIDE'. Goods/services: a downloadable iOS app and SaaS web product that uses computer vision to score and coach long-distance runners on their gait efficiency. Founder is a Delaware C-Corp HQ'd in California, primary market is US consumer runners. Intent-to-use — no commercial launch yet. We want a freedom-to-operate read before filing TEAS Plus.

Proposed mark: 'EASY TAX'. Goods/services: tax-preparation software for small business owners (SaaS web product). Texas LLC. Use-in-commerce: we've been operating under this name for 4 months and processed 30 returns. We want to know whether this clears trademark search before we invest in marketing under it.

Proposed mark: 'SOLSTICE' for direct-to-consumer athleisure apparel (Class 25). California LLC, will sell on Shopify + Amazon. Intent-to-use. Apparel is a crowded class — we suspect there are many SOLSTICE-like marks. Run a comprehensive search.

Proposed mark: 'PIXELHARE'. Goods/services: (1) a downloadable iOS/Android app for AI-assisted photo retouching (Class 9), and (2) a SaaS web platform offering the same retouching as a subscription service (Class 42). Both share the same mark. New York LLC, intent-to-use. We need both classes — confirm pricing impact and search both classes.

Proposed mark: 'PHOENIX RISE' for an online learning platform for professional certifications in cybersecurity. The English meaning is obvious. We want to know about marks containing 'PHOENIX' AND 'RISING'/'RISE' across both education (Class 41) and downloadable software (Class 9). Delaware C-Corp, intent-to-use, primary market is US-based cyber pros.
